description: This file implements Code 93 barcode encoding, including standard and extended variants, with classes for validation and encoding of barcode data.

classes.name: Standard93
classes.description: Class for encoding and validating standard Code 93 barcodes, supporting options like size and quiet zones.

classes.name: Extended93
classes.description: Class for encoding extended Code 93 barcodes that support the full ASCII set.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the barcode data against allowed characters for standard or extended Code 93.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the validated data into the Code 93 barcode pattern.
